import { chromium } from 'playwright'
const OUT='C:/Users/lty/AppData/Local/Temp/shots/'
const b=await chromium.launch()
const errs=[]
async function run(w,h,tag,extra={}){
  const ctx=await b.newContext({viewport:{width:w,height:h},...extra}); const p=await ctx.newPage()
  p.on('pageerror',e=>errs.push(tag+' pageerror '+e.message))
  p.on('console',m=>{if(m.type()==='error')errs.push(tag+' console '+m.text())})
  await p.goto('http://localhost:4173/',{waitUntil:'networkidle'})
  await p.evaluate(async()=>{for(let y=0;y<document.body.scrollHeight;y+=400){window.scrollTo({top:y,behavior:'instant'});await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60))}})
  // power path: trace to the balance wheel (stage 5)
  await p.locator('.stage').nth(4).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
  await p.locator('.stage').nth(4).locator('button').hover()
  await p.waitForTimeout(600)
  errs.push(tag+' spine fill = '+await p.evaluate(()=>getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.path-spine-fill')).height))
  await p.locator('#path').screenshot({path:OUT+tag+'-path.png'})
  // layers: open the main plate
  await p.locator('.layer-row').nth(1).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
  await p.locator('.layer-row').nth(1).hover()
  await p.waitForTimeout(700)
  await p.locator('#layers').screenshot({path:OUT+tag+'-layers.png'})
  // reserve
  await p.locator('#reserve').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
  await p.locator('label[data-config="skeleton"]').click()
  await p.waitForTimeout(300)
  await p.locator('input[name="name"]').fill('Marta Küng')
  await p.locator('input[type="email"]').fill('m.kueng@example.ch')
  await p.locator('button[type="submit"]').click()
  await p.waitForTimeout(600)
  const status = await p.locator('[role="status"]').innerText()
  errs.push(tag+' CONFIRMATION: '+status.replace(/\n/g,' | '))
  await p.locator('#reserve').screenshot({path:OUT+tag+'-reserved.png'})
  await ctx.close()
}
await run(1440,900,'desk')

await run(1440,900,'rm',{reducedMotion:'reduce'})
